tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings
tool_schemas.description: Performs the requested operator/session or server-management action: sign in/out and fetch the current session, list/get/create/update/delete registered Supabase server configurations, and list/create/update/revoke credentials; list actions return a page of results ordered by `sort` with up to `limit` items and an opaque `cursor` to retrieve the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields for the chosen `action` are missing, IDs do not match their required prefixes/patterns, `limit`/`sort`/`status`/`credential_type` are invalid, or the supplied `server`/`credential` objects include unsupported properties; raises UNAUTHORIZED when `session_token` is missing/invalid/expired for protected actions or when email/password are incorrect for `sign_in`, and FORBIDDEN when the authenticated operator is not allowed to access or modify the targeted operator/server/credential. Raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced `operator_id`, `session_id`, `server_id`, or `credential_id` does not exist or is not visible to the operator; raises CONFLICT when attempting invalid lifecycle changes (e.g., updating a deleted server, revoking an already revoked/expired credential, or creating a credential with a `server_id` that does not match the targeted server action).

action.description: Operation to perform for managing operator sessions and Supabase-backed servers.

session_token.description: Operator session token used to authenticate requests after sign-in.

operator_id.description: Operator ID (mcp_opr_...) for queries that target a specific operator.

session_id.description: Session ID (mcp_sess_...) for fetching or revoking a specific session.

server_id.description: Supabase server ID (mcp_srv_...) for get/update/delete and credential operations.

credential_id.description: Server credential ID (mcp_cred_...) for updating or revoking a credential.

email.description: Operator email address used for sign-in.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort order for list results (prefix with '-' for descending).

status.description: Status filter for list operations (interpreted based on the resource being listed).

credential_type.description: Credential type for filtering or creating server credentials.

server.description: Fields for creating or updating a supabase_servers record.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the registered Supabase server.

base_url.description: Base URL for the Supabase API (e.g., https://<project>.supabase.co).

owner_operator_id.description: Operator ID that owns this server configuration.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the server configuration.

notes.description: Optional operator notes about this server.

credential.description: Fields for creating or updating a server_credentials record.

server_id.description: Server ID this credential belongs to.

secret.description: Raw secret material to store (will be encrypted at rest).

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: get_operator
tool_schemas.description: Returns the operator profile for the authenticated session_token (id, email, display_name, role, status, last_login_at, failed_login_count, created_at, updated_at); refuses if the session is missing, revoked, expired, or the operator is disabled/locked.

action.description: Operation to perform for reading the current authenticated operator.

session_token.description: Operator session token used to authenticate requests after sign-in.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: list_operators
tool_schemas.description: Lists operators visible to the authenticated operator (typically owner/admin only); returns a page of operator records ordered by sort with up to limit items and an opaque cursor; refuses if the session is invalid or the caller lacks permission.

action.description: Operation to perform for listing operators.

session_token.description: Operator session token used to authenticate requests after sign-in.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort order for list results (prefix with '-' for descending).

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: create_operator
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new operator (owner/admin only) with an initial password; returns the created operator record; refuses if caller lacks permission, email is already in use, or inputs fail validation.

action.description: Operation to perform for creating an operator.

session_token.description: Operator session token used to authenticate requests after sign-in.

operator.description: Fields for creating an operators record. Password is accepted only on create/reset and is never returned.

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: update_operator
tool_schemas.description: Updates an operator (owner/admin only), including lifecycle transitions via status; returns the updated operator record; refuses invalid transitions, attempts to change protected fields without permission, or invalid input.

action.description: Operation to perform for updating an operator.

session_token.description: Operator session token used to authenticate requests after sign-in.

operator.description: Fields for updating an operators record. To unlock an operator, set status to active (owner/admin only).

status.description: Updated lifecycle status (must follow allowed transitions).

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: list_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists sessions for the authenticated operator (or for a specified operator_id if owner/admin); returns a page ordered by sort with up to limit items and a cursor; refuses if the session is invalid or caller lacks permission.

action.description: Operation to perform for listing sessions.

session_token.description: Operator session token used to authenticate requests after sign-in.

operator_id.description: Filter sessions by operator id (owner/admin only when different from current operator).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort order for list results (prefix with '-' for descending).

tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlements for the provided session_token, including operator id/email/role/status, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota counters; refuses if the session is missing, revoked, or expired (and may mark it expired when appropriate).

action.description: Operation to perform for retrieving the authenticated identity, scopes, and quota/rate-limit status.

session_token.description: Operator session token used to authenticate requests after sign-in.

metadata.name: Self-Hosted Supabase MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores configuration and access control for a self-hosted Supabase MCP server, centered around authenticating an operator and managing registered Supabase-backed servers. The primary workflow is: an operator signs in, receives a session, and then uses that session to view/manage server
